title: U.S. adds aerial refueling aircraft in Israel; on X, open-source accounts claim a Europe-to-Middle East airbridge
summary: The U.S. is reinforcing tanker aircraft in Israel as fighting with Iran intensifies — planes that top up other aircraft in flight so they can stay on station longer. Separately, people on X watching flight trackers said they were seeing a surge of transport flights from Europe into the Middle East. That airbridge claim is social sensing here, not independently verified logistics fact.
